BEFORE YOU ARRIVE

Stay with
the details sorted.

Arrival & guest questions →
When are check-in and checkout?+
Check-in starts after 2 p.m. Checkout is at 10 a.m. Arriving after front-desk hours? Contact us before arrival to arrange contactless check-in and receive your instructions.
Are pets welcome?+
Yes, we are pet friendly for an extra fee. Tell the team about your pet before booking so they can confirm the fee and a suitable room.
How do I check room prices and availability?+
Check live room availability on ResNexus. Choose your dates there once, compare available rooms, and review the full price and reservation terms before confirming.
